complexity.notes: Clean and idiomatic; the `bracket in "({["` membership check on a short string is fine and readable. The dict lookups are the only hash-dependent part; worst case reflects adversarial hash collisions, though the tiny fixed key set makes this purely theoretical.
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push opening brackets, and on each closing bracket check that the stack's top is the matching opener via a lookup dict. Returns false early on any mismatch or empty-stack pop, and requires an empty stack at the end.
